From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Weekly leadership roundup: spotlight wins, current risks, and asks (pre-QBR)

Team —

Sharing a concise snapshot for the exec distro ahead of next week's QBR. Short bullets (wins / risks / asks) so we can collate into the slide pack. Please reply with any additions and any blocking asks by 11:30 PT.

WINS:
- Hosted: 20% latency improvement on small-batch NLP routes after kernel patch; rollout to prod completed 02/12. Early customers (education cohort) reporting smoother UX.
- Dedicated: Closed two new Dedicated pilot agreements (one enterprise, one growth) — combined ~$480k ARR potential; legal is finalizing SOWs.
- Console: New token-level billing dashboard shipped to staging; internal cost ops can now attribute spend to route tags.

RISKS / OPEN ITEMS:
- SOC2 evidence: Controls testing window narrowed by auditor; we need final access logs export (see attachment: Support-Incident-Timeline-0207.xlsx) and a one-line confirmation from Infra that retention policy export completed. Impact: potential delay on attestation deliverables if misses deadline.
- Model routing: A subset of customers on eu-region saw fallback thrash on 02/13 during a GPU driver upgrade; root cause in autoscaler policy mismatch — mitigation in progress but may require a short maintenance window.
- QBR narrative: We are missing a clear unit-economics bullet for long-tail low-traffic routes to explain batching gains — request finance & product to confirm numbers.

ASKS (what I need from you):
- Vivek: one-line from Infra confirming logs export + retention policy status by 10:30 PT.
- Laura: add two slides on Customer Success/renewal signal (1) early churn indicators, (2) top renewal at-risk account summary.
- Maya/Markus: provide the unit-economics delta for batching (tokens/unit and expected savings) for the QBR slide by EOD.
- Tessa: confirm speaker/owner for the QBR incident timeline and whether we want the Support timeline attached (I attached draft).

Attachments: QBR_Highlights_2027_v1.pdf (draft), Support-Incident-Timeline-0207.xlsx (timeline export)

Thanks — keeping this short so it can be copy/pasted into the pack.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Operations, Redwood Inference
